reports.title: ADMA Biologics Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update

lines: FY2026 total revenue expected to be at least $530 million
FY2026 Adjusted Net Income expected to be at least $180 million
FY2026 Adjusted EBITDA expected to be at least $275 million

desk.headline: Revenue up 5% to $141.1m, beat; adjusted profit floors for 2026 raised, revenue outlook held

numbers.eps_basis: adjusted basic (GAAP basic and diluted EPS $0.22 vs $0.15)

results: Revenue rose 5% to $141.1m (13% up on Q2) as ASCENIV sales jumped 31% to $124.7m, offsetting a 35% drop in BIVIGAM to $15.4m.
Gross margin widened to 71% from 56% a year ago, helped by the richer ASCENIV mix and higher manufacturing yields.
Net income rose 37% to $49.9m; adjusted EPS was $0.23 against $0.16, and adjusted EBITDA grew 32% to $77.3m.
Nine-month operating cash flow was $105.2m; 2.7m shares were bought back in the quarter and 16.5m (6.3% of shares) so far this year.
Debt rose to about $196m after $125m was drawn on the revolving facility this year, partly funding buybacks.

guidance.summary: ADMA kept its 2026 revenue floor of at least $530m and raised its minimum targets for adjusted net income and adjusted EBITDA by $10m each. The earlier outlook (Q2 release) was given as ranges; the new outlook gives only floors.

points: Management said strong ASCENIV demand from new patients and wider doctor use has carried on into Q4.
BIVIGAM use is showing early signs of steadying; ADMA says it will not match rivals' heavy discounting.
The company says it is on track for at least $200m of share buybacks in 2026.
FDA feedback on the SG-001 pneumonia antibody plan was constructive; ADMA is preparing an IND filing and sees a $300–500m yearly sales opportunity if approved.
Q4 research spending was guided to about $10m as SG-001 work steps up.
call.source: Company release (Exhibit 99.1); call summaries: 24/7 Wall St, 4 Nov 2026; Quartr event summary, 4 Nov 2026

watch: Whether ASCENIV growth holds up in Q4 and BIVIGAM sales stop falling.
The SG-001 IND filing and the clinical trial timeline.
Buyback pace and debt levels after the $125m revolver draw.
